basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bibinagar Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bibinagar (AIIMS Bibinagar) has notified 1 vacancy for the Administrative Officer post on a deputation basis. Eligible applicants can apply through the prescribed offline process by sending the hard copy of their application via Speed Post or Courier to The Chairperson (Recruitment Cell), All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bibinagar, Hyderabad on or before 29 November 2026. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bibinagar Administrative Officer at a Glance

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bibinagar
Officers under Central/State/U.T. Governments/Universities/Statutory/Autonomous Bodies or R&D Organizations with regular service/analogous posts

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must send a printout of the filled-in application form on the prescribed proforma (Annexure I), duly signed on each page along with self-attested copies of all certificates and documents, through Speed Post or Courier (not by hand or in person) to the following address: The Chairperson (Recruitment Cell), All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bibinagar, Hyderabad - 508126. Applicants may also send a scanned copy of the filled-in application to the email address [email protected] as an advance copy. The advance copy is for information purposes only, and merely sending an advance copy without the hard copy will not be considered as a valid application. The envelope containing the application should be superscribed as “Application for the Post of Administrative Officer on Deputation Basis” .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Officers under the Central, State, or U.T. Governments, Universities, Statutory, Autonomous Bodies, or Research and Development Organizations must fulfill either of the following requirements: Holding analogous posts on regular basis, OR With 2 to 3 years of regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 4,800/- or 4,600/- respectively in the relevant field.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates must enclose the following documents along with their hard copy application: Self-attested copies of certificates and documents in support of age, educational qualifications, and experiences. Duly attested photocopies of up-to-date Confidential Reports (at least for the latest 05 years) / CR Dossiers. Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate (forwarded through proper channel by the parent cadre or department).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is governed by the standard terms and conditions of deputation provided under Department of Personnel and Training O.M. No.2/6/2018-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 18.05.2018, as amended from time to time. The information and details provided by candidates in the Curriculum Vitae, supported by documents in respect of essential qualifications and work experience, will be assessed by a Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post being recruited for at AIIMS Bibinagar?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bibinagar is recruiting for the post of Administrative Officer on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Administrative Officer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bibinagar Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the completed application through the proper channel is 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay scale for the Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The post carries a pay scale of Level-10 as per the 7th CPC, with a salary range of Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply for this deputation post?
faq.answer: Officers under Central, State, or U.T. Governments, Universities, Statutory, Autonomous Bodies, or R&D Organizations holding analogous posts on a regular basis or having 2 to 3 years of regular service in the grade pay of Rs. 4,800 or 4,600 respectively are eligible.

faq.question: Q6. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by sending a printout of the filled-in proforma via Speed Post or Courier to the Recruitment Cell at AIIMS Bibinagar, along with an advance copy sent via email.

faq.question: Q7. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose self-attested copies of educational, age, and experience certificates, up-to-date Confidential Reports for the latest 5 years, and vigilance clearance through the proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
